rationale: Both list Phaathmoab and the Iesoue/Jesus and Ioab/Joab grouping, but the totals are 2812 here and 2818 there; the source name forms and figures remain distinct.

The anticipated illuminating and perfect things concern priestly discernment, resembling the Manifestation and Truth placed on Aaron's judgment-piece; the expressions in the supplied translation have a related function but are not silently made the same wording.

Ezra's thanksgiving includes the refrain that His mercy toward Israel endures for ever, closely corresponding to the psalm's opening call to thanksgiving for the Lord's kindness and enduring mercy; Ezra says that it is good, rather than using the psalm's exact wording.
